name: 15_open_addressing_hashmap_100k
description: Hand-rolled open-addressing hash table with FNV-1a, linear probing, tombstones, and 2x growth. 100k mixed put/get/delete ops driven by a deterministic LCG. Banned: map (Go), dict (Python), hash/fnv, hashlib. Tests pure interpreter throughput on slice indexing + integer arithmetic + string equality, without any stdlib hot-path short-circuit.
